title: Cloudflare Workers — Errors Deploying Workers Scripts

updates.body: Cloudflare is investigating an issue where a subset of Workers script deployments are failing with errors. Customers may experience failures when attempting to deploy a Worker script via Wrangler or the Workers API. Workers that are already deployed and running in production are not affected. A fix is being prepared.
We are continuing to work on a fix for this issue.
This incident has been resolved.

title: Possible Network Congestion in North America region

updates.body:
Cloudflare is observing possible network congestion in the North America region. Customers may see elevated latency and connectivity issues. 

We are working to mitigate impact to Internet users in this region.

Cloudflare identified that the Network degradation was due to maintenance conducted by fiber providers. The congestion has been alleviated by rerouting traffic. We are currently monitoring the situation and will follow up with more updates shortly.
We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
This incident has been resolved.

title: RealtimeKit socket connection slowness and failed meeting joins

updates.body:
We have identified and mitigated an issue affecting RealtimeKit socket connections, which caused slowness and meeting join failures for some users. 

Customers were impacted from 13:10 UTC to 14:15 UTC

All services have been restored, and we are continuing to monitor system performance to ensure stability.
